chapter_note: Substrate-dominant chapter on the Five Worlds/Storehouses of Darkness — clearly preserves an old correspondential teaching (face/body/taste mapping for each cosmic realm). The substrate is interrupted at predictable points by the editor's "projection/spirit reigns today in [contemporary institutions]" formula — these are clean polemic seams identifying Roman tyranny, Zoroastrian fire-cult, idol-worship, water-baptizing sects (Mandaeans), and divinatory practices as expressions of the five worlds. Strong second-half editorial fatigue (manichaean_ecclesial +5.9, manichaean_polemic +5.2) confirms that the polemic identifications are LATER than the cosmic mapping itself — the substrate face/body/taste schema would be complete without them. The chapter closes with a pure hortatory peroration to the elect (i=134-140).
